title: A requireProvenance signal that is absent produces an evidence-indicator with a basis
rationale: The basis requirement is checked by the runner on every result, so this vector only has to establish that the indicator fires at all. An engine that surfaced a truth judgement instead of a checkable basis fails the universal invariant, not this assertion.

requirement.text: For each signal named in interpretation.sources.requireProvenance ... the engine MUST check for the signal’s presence and surface an evidence-indicator when it is absent, with a basis describing the check performed.

priorities.rationale: I want to notice who keeps data on the device.

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
A state audit published in 2024 found gaps in vendor contracts, with 40 districts affected according to the published report.
